mappings.testId: bun:tests/unit/pptx.test.ts:pptx slice / acceptance feature passes with the dedicated PPTX bindings
outcomes: The isolated shared-feature project selects exactly four original PPTX scenarios; runAcceptance returns passed, one implemented feature and four passing cases.
gaps: Direct assertions inspect aggregate status and counts, not individual Then values. Outcome checks reside in the pinned acceptance bindings; this declaration gives no independent assertion credit to newer notes or no-op scenarios.

mappings.testId: bun:tests/unit/pptx.test.ts:pptx slice / follows presentation relationships, preserves notes blank lines and visible fields, and keeps notes reads read-only
assertions:
expect(result.notes).toEqual([
      "Key themes:\ncreation, responsibility, isolation\n\nVisible date: 2026-03-12",
      "Compare to Prometheus myth",
    ])
outcomes: Five expected slide titles follow relationship order; two notes strings include the expected blank line and visible date. Ordered package diff is empty and whole archive bytes match. Missing notes throw PPTX_NOTES_MISSING with unchanged archive and no created notes parts.
gaps: Only first and last slides have notes text asserted; the test does not enumerate every paragraph, notes field or package. Rendering and write support are untested here.

mappings.testId: bun:tests/unit/pptx.test.ts:pptx slice / exposes line breaks and field text in inspectText and refuses editing that topology atomically
assertions:
expect(result.paragraphRuns).toEqual([
      { text: "Chapter", attrs: { b: "1" } },
      { text: "\n", attrs: { lang: "en-US" } },
      { text: "7", attrs: { i: "1" } },
      { text: " Notes", attrs: { u: "sng" } },
    ])
outcomes: Paragraph Chapter LF 7 Notes and four text/run-attribute entries match exactly. Attempted anchored editing returns PPTX_UNSUPPORTED_TEXT_TOPOLOGY, empty package diff and unchanged source archive bytes.
gaps: One synthetic paragraph from the real template is asserted; broader field types, formatting inheritance and rendering are outside this declaration.

mappings.testId: bun:tests/unit/pptx.test.ts:pptx slice / replaces exact anchored text across runs and preserves untouched members
assertions:
expect(result.titleRuns).toEqual([
      { text: "Fr", attrs: { b: "1" } },
      { text: "iend", attrs: { b: "1" } },
      { text: "stein", attrs: { u: "sng" } },
    ])
outcomes: A path save and reopen reads Friendstein; in-memory diff lists only slide1.xml changed. Saved custom/data.bin and docProps/app.xml bytes match, and saved title runs retain the exact asserted starting-run formatting.
gaps: Only two unrelated saved members are compared; the in-memory changed-part list is not a complete saved-archive member diff. Other run properties and rendering are not asserted.

mappings.testId: bun:tests/unit/pptx.test.ts:pptx slice / refuses stale anchors atomically
outcomes: A reused anchor throws PPTX_STALE_ANCHOR; post-refusal bytes equal the preceding successful edit, and reopening reads Creature.
gaps: One held anchor and one title are tested; foreign handles, other cache changes and all untouched member comparisons are outside this declaration.

mappings.testId: bun:tests/unit/pptx.test.ts:pptx slice / opens from path and bytes and saves a no-op deck byte-identically
outcomes: The pinned title-slide fixture opens by path and bytes. The first path-inspected title is Frankenstein, byte-open serialization equals the input, and a path save delivers exact original archive bytes.
gaps: One no-op presentation is tested. The native declaration reads saved bytes but does not reopen the saved path; the separate acceptance binding adds that check. Path-open toBytes and byte-open disk save are not independently asserted. No edited-presentation serialization or rendering claim.
